design.aggregation_status: declared synthetic research scale: 20 identical public prototype copies, not20 real houses or a surveyed local building
design.part_load: hypothetical ideal hourly duty: heat=duty*catalogueQ, power=duty*catalogueP, 0<=duty<=1; no tested inverter/cycling curve
design.capacity_scope: single whole module; unit count integer and fixed; rated-water-flow catalogue condition, ideal exchanger
design.cooling_scope: separate hypothetical finite cooler, not a TICA cooling performance claim

controller: LP full-window dispatch; exact continuous RC, common service envelope and fixed terminal; ideal-duty catalogue hypothesis remains
monetary_scope: operating electricity energy charge only; sum(price_CNY_per_kWh*grid_kW*dt_h), no fixed/demand charge, tax adjustment, capex or maintenance
price_scope: published Hubei low-voltage industrial/commercial monthly TOU conditionally applied to all cities as common methodological axis; Wuhan geography matches Hubei but account eligibility/connection is not verified in any city; no actual local bill prediction
emissions_scope: same admitted Hubei2022 annual grid factor applied as common methodological axis; not hourly marginal carbon or other-city local factor
data_scope: NASA POWER gridded weather/reanalysis and published prototype/tariff; not site measurements or fitted local H/C
catalogue_scope: manufacturer-authored sample distributed by third-party; exact PDF SHA and all165 Q/P checked; grid wet bulb/flow detail/defrost integration unspecified
excluded: pump/fan standby beyond catalogue input boundary
claim: conditional operating comparison under explicit catalogue and ideal-duty assumptions, not realized equipment savings or final investment recommendation
optimization: minimize electricity energy charge; fixed1 whole module and fixed90kW resistance/80kW separate cooler/100kW grid; perfect foresight; no investment variables or capital constants
service_comparison: same20..27C/continuousinitial-terminal20C and same assets; temperature trajectories may differ inside shared comfort envelope
solver_bound_scope: dual lower bound for electricity energy-charge objective only; no cost bound asserted for carbon KPI, investment or complete bill
